resources.string: Material 3 Expressive BMI, Body Composition & Health Tracker

BMI Pulse is an informational wellness tool and is not a medical device. BMI, body fat estimates, BMR/TDEE, and percentile calculations are screening metrics and do not diagnose medical conditions. Always consult a qualified physician or healthcare professional before starting a diet, weight loss, or exercise program, especially during pregnancy, adolescence, or when managing chronic conditions.
